description: File existing items into a collection, keeping every collection they already belong to. An item in Zotero can sit in any number of collections, so this adds rather than moves. Items already in the collection are reported as unchanged and cost no write.

groupId.description: Group library ID. Omit for the personal library ("My Library"), which is what almost every request wants. Group IDs come from zotero_list_libraries.

itemKeys.description: Keys of the items to file.

name: zotero_add_items_to_collection
title: Add items to a collection
